scope: Read-only source cartography of current RC718 content, import, persistence and learner-state identity semantics. This file records current behavior; it does not claim implementation of the target identity model.

evidence.observation: Engineering guidance states that localCourseId is immutable after import, importPackageId is the immutable technical plan identity in current behavior, and importCollectionTitle is editable presentation.
The model derives a fallback course ID from the normalized title and groups imported courses under import:<importPackageId>.
The import and state owner assigns localCourseId, synthesizes installed plan IDs, persists imported payloads and keys learner state by course and activity compatibility keys.
Course evidence prefers course.id then a title-derived fallback; objective identity is normalized text; chapter IDs can be generated from position.
The current contract requires course-scoped activity IDs and asset references but does not define globally stable package-version, course, objective or activity-revision identity.
A representative package uses human-authored package/content version strings, course-scoped activity IDs, package-local asset IDs and variant_of references to activity compatibility keys.
Current regression evidence protects localCourseId stability through rename and title-safe progress behavior, not global cross-device lineage.
The target constitution requires opaque stable IDs independent of titles and lineage across package, package version, course, objective, activity and activity revision.

identifiers.name: sourcePackageId
identifiers.generation: author supplied; fallback package-<Date.now()> when absent
identifiers.collisionBehavior: not the final installed plan key
identifiers.risk: The field is optional in runtime behavior and its uniqueness or immutability is not globally enforced.
identifiers.targetDisposition: retain legacy meaning in v1.1; add explicit canonical package lineage and package-version identity in a new envelope

identifiers.name: installedImportPackageId
identifiers.generation: plan-<FNV-style digest of resolved import operations>
identifiers.mutableLabelDerived: indirectly, because resolved operations and legacy IDs can reflect title-based collision handling
identifiers.collisionBehavior: same local digest groups courses; title is separately editable
identifiers.risk: The name suggests package lineage but current semantics are local installed-plan identity.
identifiers.targetDisposition: map to collectionInstallId; keep source canonical package identity separate

identifiers.name: localCourseId
identifiers.currentScope: one installed course on the local library
identifiers.generation: existing value or title-derived courseSlugFromTitle/courseIdFromContent with --<n> collision suffix
identifiers.collisionBehavior: suffix is assigned until locally unique; rename later preserves the assigned value
identifiers.risk: It is durable and progress-safe locally but initial allocation is derived from editable title/collision context and cannot prove global semantic identity.
identifiers.targetDisposition: preserve as legacyCourseKey; introduce courseInstallId and optional canonical course lineage/revision

identifiers.name: fallbackCourseId
identifiers.generation: course.id when present, otherwise normalized title
persistence: may become current state map key through runtime helpers
identifiers.collisionBehavior: not centrally governed across all models
identifiers.risk: Different helpers can choose course.id, localCourseId or title fallback, creating ambiguous identity precedence.
identifiers.targetDisposition: one explicit resolver with legacy fallback and diagnostic classification before any write migration

identifiers.name: activityCompatibilityId
identifiers.currentScope: unique only inside one course payload
identifiers.collisionBehavior: duplicates inside one course are rejected; reuse across courses is expected
identifiers.risk: There is no immutable activity revision identity; reusing an ID after a semantic change can silently reinterpret historical evidence.
identifiers.targetDisposition: retain as legacyActivityKey; add canonical activityId and activityRevisionId

identifiers.name: objectiveCompatibilityKey
identifiers.currentField: activity.objective string normalized by mastery model
persistence: usually derived, not stored as an explicit ID
identifiers.collisionBehavior: different labels can split one objective; similar labels can merge distinct objectives
identifiers.risk: Editing wording can fragment evidence and normalization can conflate semantically different objectives.
identifiers.targetDisposition: add objectiveCatalog and explicit objectiveId references; keep labels mutable

identifiers.name: contentVersion
identifiers.risk: It is useful version metadata but cannot prove immutable course or activity revision identity.
identifiers.targetDisposition: retain as legacy version label; add package/course/activity revision IDs and canonical digests

identifiers.name: assetCompatibilityId
persistence: imported course assets and media references
identifiers.collisionBehavior: duplicates in the validated asset list are rejected
identifiers.risk: The ID is a local reference without lineage or revision semantics.
identifiers.targetDisposition: retain local reference during compatibility; add canonical asset lineage identity

identifiers.name: chapterCompatibilityId
identifiers.generation: author supplied when explicit; otherwise generated from position/objective grouping
identifiers.collisionBehavior: position changes can produce a different generated key
identifiers.risk: Not safe for durable evidence or cross-version lineage.
identifiers.targetDisposition: do not use generated chapter keys as canonical evidence identity; future explicit chapter identity requires its own need and gate

identifiers.name: patchTargetKeys
identifiers.generation: current course compatibility key plus activity compatibility ID
identifiers.mutableLabelDerived: course key can originate from title-derived allocation
identifiers.risk: A future identity migration must preserve or explicitly translate patch targets before changing read keys.
identifiers.targetDisposition: include patch translation in a later transactional migration; no change in the first resolver seam

claims: RC718 already protects local progress through course and plan title rename.
Current identity is sufficient for the promoted standalone behavior but not for global lineage or safe semantic revision migration.
The safest first seam is read-only classification and diagnostics because current persisted maps are densely keyed by legacy course and activity identifiers.
A destructive in-place key rewrite would couple identity migration to persistence and learner-state recovery and is therefore not an acceptable first step.
assumptions: Future authored canonical IDs can be allocated offline with collision-resistant opaque identifiers.
A future package contract can carry complete identity envelopes without changing current display labels.
Progress applicability across revisions will require explicit compatibility decisions rather than label matching.
absenceOfEvidence: No executable proof currently establishes global uniqueness of packageId, course IDs, activity IDs or contentVersion across publishers or devices.
No current contract binds package, course or activity revision IDs to immutable canonical payload digests.
No current migration proves atomic translation of every learner-state and patch reference to a new identity namespace.
No current mixed-version test proves legacy-only and canonical packages can coexist because the canonical envelope is not implemented.
No current synchronization evidence exists, and synchronization remains held.

verdict.decision: Proceed only to ARC-WP-021 additive read-only identity resolver authorization
